lucidity.name: Fantastic Imagination
lucidity.text: Reveal 1 Landscape. If Lucidity 0-2, Reveal +1. If Lucidity 3+, Return 3 Cards.

lucidity.name: Morning Routine
lucidity.text: Draw 1 Psyche. Draw Psyche up to Landscapes Affected.

lucidity.name: Forgot Clothes
lucidity.text: Repress 1 Psyche from hand. If Lucidity 1-2, Move adjacent. If Lucidity 3+, Move anywhere.

lucidity.name: Transported
lucidity.text: Draw 2 Psyche. 1st is column, 2nd is row of Dreamscape. Move to this Landscape.

lucidity.name: Harmonic Resonance
lucidity.text: If Lucidity 1, Draw 1 Psyche. If Lucidity 3+, Return 2 Cards. Draw +1 Psyche or Return +2.

lucidity.name: A Face Appears
lucidity.text: Spawn 1 Encounter from Lucidity Mindstream. If Lucidity 3+, Return 3 Cards.

lucidity.name: Pop Quiz
lucidity.text: Draw 1 Psyche. Guess if next Psyche is Higher or Lower. Correct: Return Personae+3.

lucidity.name: Centering
lucidity.text: Draw 2 Psyche. All Dreamers Draw 1 Psyche & 1 Power Token, then Move adjacent.

lucidity.name: The Ascent
lucidity.text: Discard your highest Psyche, then Draw 2 Psyche. Dreamers on Affected Landscapes may also use this effect.

lucidity.name: Sacred Geometry
lucidity.text: Move to any Landscape adjacent to Bed. Return 2 Cards per Affected Landscape.

lucidity.name: Just a Dream
lucidity.text: Draw 3 Psyche. Return 1 Card for each Landscape Affected.

lucidity.name: Lucid Glimpse
lucidity.text: Reveal 2 Landscapes. Draw 2 Psyche. Return 1 Card.

lucidity.name: Dream Logic
lucidity.text: Return 2 Cards. All Dreamers Draw 1 Psyche.

lucidity.name: Beyond Comprehension
lucidity.text: Flip Leviathan. Instead, Forget 4 Landscapes. Return 4 cards.

lucidity.name: Awakening Spark
lucidity.text: Reveal all hidden Landscapes. Return 3 Cards.

elasticity.name: Roof Dive
elasticity.text: Elasticity 3+, Move to Sky, The Party, or Candy Mountain.

elasticity.name: Get Up
elasticity.text: Draw 1 Psyche from Discard. May Move to Forest if Revealed. Move to Attic and take free Meet.

elasticity.name: Get Down
elasticity.text: Draw 1 Psyche from Discard. May Move to City if Revealed. Move to Basement and take free Meet.

elasticity.name: Into The Next
elasticity.text: All Dreamers Draw 1 Psyche. Move to adjacent Landscape & take a free Action.

elasticity.name: Friendship
elasticity.text: Reveal 2 Landscapes. Move to either. Elasticity 3+, 1 Free Action.

elasticity.name: Break-out
elasticity.text: Discard 1 Psyche. Draw 1 Psyche. If it matches hand, Return 4 Cards.

elasticity.name: Running Somewhere?
elasticity.text: Draw 1 Psyche. Elasticity 3+, may Discard 1 Psyche to Return cards equal to value.

elasticity.name: Revolving
elasticity.text: Draw 3 Psyche. You swap Positions with any other Dreamer.

elasticity.name: Freezing Night
elasticity.text: Elasticity 0-2, Draw 2 Psyche keep 1. Willpower 3+, Draw 2 Objects keep 1.

elasticity.name: A Shining Wind
elasticity.text: If Elasticity 3+, take 2 Power Tokens. Move to Silver Mist or Endless Ocean.

elasticity.name: Blooming
elasticity.text: Swap Positions of any 4 unoccupied Landscape Hexes.

elasticity.name: Elastic Step
elasticity.text: Move to any adjacent Landscape. Draw 1 Psyche.

elasticity.name: Undulating Floor
elasticity.text: Move to Any Landscape. Place 1 Power Token on an available Archetype.

elasticity.name: Rubber Soul
elasticity.text: Move any Dreamer to your Landscape. Draw 1 Psyche.

elasticity.name: Dream Drift
elasticity.text: All Dreamers may Move 1 space. Return 2 Cards.

elasticity.name: Portal to Another World
elasticity.text: Elasticity 0-2 Move 1. Elasticity 3+ Move 3. Move to edge of Dreamscape.

elasticity.name: Infinite Corridor
elasticity.text: Move to any edge Landscape. Draw 2 Psyche.

elasticity.name: Phase Shift
elasticity.text: Swap with any Dreamer. Both Draw 2 Psyche.

willpower.name: Get Up
willpower.text: Draw 1 Psyche from Discard. May Move to Forest if Revealed. Move to Attic and take free Meet.

willpower.name: Grit
willpower.text: Discard 1 Psyche from hand, Draw 2 Psyche.

willpower.name: A Thousand Daggers
willpower.text: All Dreamers collectively Discard Dreamers+2 Psyche.

willpower.name: Choppy Water
willpower.text: Discard 1 Willpower Psyche to Draw 1 Psyche and Return 4 Cards.

willpower.name: Iron Will
willpower.text: Take 1 Power Token. Repress top 1 Psyche from hand.

willpower.name: Clear as Crystal
willpower.text: Willpower 2 or less: Draw 3 Psyche. Willpower 3+: Draw 3 Psyche and Return 2.

willpower.name: Golden Tooth
willpower.text: Willpower 1-2: Draw 2 Psyche. Willpower 3+: Draw 1 Object from any Mindstream.

willpower.name: Heating Up
willpower.text: Spawn 1 Encounter, Meet it. If Accept spawn another; if Repress Draw Psyche up to hand limit.

willpower.name: Who's There?
willpower.text: Spawn an Encounter and Meet Now. Instead, Draw 2 Encounters, Pick 1.

willpower.name: Battle Cry
willpower.text: Spawn 1 Encounter on active Landscape. Draw 1 Psyche.

willpower.name: No One
willpower.text: Discard all active Encounters. Willpower 3+, Instead Discard 1 Encounter.

willpower.name: Jaw Shark
willpower.text: Discard 2 Willpower Psyche or else Discard all Objects.

willpower.name: A Sacrifice!
willpower.text: Discard 1 Object to Return Dreamers+1 Objects. Repress Encounters on Affected Landscapes.

willpower.name: Metamorphosis
willpower.text: Repress Active Encounters+2 top Psyche. Forget 2 Landscapes per Affected Landscape.

willpower.name: Last Stand
willpower.text: All Dreamers Draw 2 Psyche. Spawn 1 Encounter per Dreamer.
